name: appstore-data-api
title: App Store Public Reads
description: Read-only access to public App Store application data: application lookup by track ID or bundle ID, bounded term search, and related-app listings. Requests use Bearer workspace-key authentication or truthful x402 v2 payment negotiation when the service returns HTTP 402. No purchase, review, account, login, or other mutation is supported.
surface_status: This package documents three stable, read-only GET operations with bounded requests and normalized v1 responses.
The public routes are stable capability identifiers for agent tool bindings.
No availability, uptime, latency, success-rate, or payment-settlement claim is made; example payloads are illustrative fixtures.

source_of_truth.purpose: Public sanitized provenance for the App Store read-skill package and its release artifacts.

distribution.note: Registry status is verified independently after publication.

capabilities.summary: Look up one public App Store application
Search public App Store applications by term
List public apps related to one App Store application

unsupported_capabilities.name: list
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Storefront ranking crawls; high volume, deferred beyond #15.

unsupported_capabilities.name: developer (standalone)
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Developer catalog enumeration; deferred beyond #15. Developer name/id are embedded in app records when available.

unsupported_capabilities.name: reviews (standalone)
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Paged user reviews; pagination contract deferred beyond #15. Review count is embedded in app records as rating.reviews_count when available.

unsupported_capabilities.name: ratings (standalone)
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Standalone ratings fetch; deferred beyond #15. Average score and counts are embedded in app records as rating.score, rating.ratings_count when available.

unsupported_capabilities.name: *write_or_authenticated
unsupported_capabilities.notes: No purchase, review submission, account, login, or authenticated capability exists on this boundary, now or later.
